Subject: Handoff: CuraSense deployment — owners, timeline, and kickoff

Hi Samir / Leah,

Great to have CuraSense over the line — congratulations to the whole deal team. I'm starting the Sales -> CS handoff so we can lock the go-live plan. High-level context and asks below.

Deal summary (quick):
- SKU: Redwood Hosted Inference (4x GPU reserved, burst to 8x) + 25M embeddings/mo
- Contract value (annual): $540k; expected signature this week (DocuSign link below)
- Target production go-live: 2027-01-18 (customer prefers mid-Jan)

Immediate handoff items for CS:
1) Confirm CS lead and implementation PM (we'd like a named owner to schedule a kickoff by 11/24)
2) Review attached SOW_draft_v3.pdf and the deployment_checklist.xlsx — two items in the SOW still open: production IP allowlist and VPC peering timeline.
3) Security & onboarding: customer will need SOC2 evidence and a network diagram — Leah will coordinate with your security contact.

Known risks / blockers:
- Procurement: customer asked for a 30-day invoice net; legal reviewing final terms (DocuSign flow in progress).
- Networking: CuraSense will request a VPC peer; engineering estimate 2–3 weeks from peering approval.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (PDF), deployment_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
Related links: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/7241 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBc-Deployment-Prep

Next steps I propose:
- Tessa / CS: assign lead + PM and confirm kickoff date by end-of-day 11/20
- Aditya (SE): please review the deployment checklist and flag any performance constraints for mid-Jan
- Samir / Leah: if mid-Jan is still good, confirm and share your security contact and an initial list of test datasets we can use for acceptance.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby for anything procurement or discounts related.

—
Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
